gloss: side by side; in a row; uniform conformity

definitions.gloss: side by side; in a row; lined up horizontally
definitions.explanation: The physical arrangement of people or things placed next to each other in a horizontal line.

definitions.gloss: uniform conformity; keeping pace with others; herd mentality
definitions.explanation: A tendency for organizations, companies, or individuals to maintain uniformity by doing the same thing as everyone else, avoiding standing out. Often used critically.

examples.japanese: {横並|よこなら}びに{座|すわ}る。
{子|こ}どもたちが{横並|よこなら}びで{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}った。
examples.english: The children took a photo lined up side by side.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}たちが{横並|よこなら}びでスタートラインに{立|た}った。
examples.english: The athletes stood side by side at the starting line.

examples.japanese: {横並|よこなら}び{意識|いしき}が{強|つよ}い。
{各社|かくしゃ}が{横並|よこなら}びの{価格|かかく}を{設定|せってい}している。
examples.english: Each company has set uniform prices.

examples.japanese: {横並|よこなら}びの{発想|はっそう}を{捨|す}てて、{独自|どくじ}の{戦略|せんりゃく}を{打|う}ち{出|だ}すべきだ。
examples.english: We should abandon the herd mentality and put forward an original strategy.

notes:
From {横|よこ} (horizontal, side) + {並|なら}び (lining up). The literal sense of physical side-by-side arrangement extends metaphorically to describe conformist behavior.

USAGE:
Sense 2 is frequently used in business and social commentary to criticize Japanese organizational culture where companies or institutions copy each other rather than innovate. Often appears with {意識|いしき} (awareness/mentality) as {横並|よこなら}び{意識|いしき}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {横並|よこなら}びに{並|なら}ぶ — to line up side by side
- {横並|よこなら}び{意識|いしき} — conformity mentality
- {横並|よこなら}びの{対応|たいおう} — uniform response (doing the same as everyone else)
- {横並|よこなら}びを{脱|だっ}する — to break away from conformity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {並列|へいれつ} — parallel, side by side (more technical/formal, no conformity nuance)
- {右|みぎ}へならえ — follow the leader, do as others do (stronger criticism of blind conformity)
- {一律|いちりつ} — uniform, across the board (focuses on identical treatment rather than herd behavior)
